messages.subject: Reading object from Shiny objects
parts:
Hello,
I have an analysis run that takes about 2 mins or so.  The analysis loops over 7 scenarios and populates a predefined array which in turn is rendered as a datatable. would also like to plot this data.  However, I cannot use the previously populated array.  The basics are outlined below.  I would like the table that is populated in renderDataTable to persist to the next step which is output$myplot.  The analysis takes about 3 mins to complete so replicating it to 6 mins is not acceptable.
server side.  Is there a way to keep the data for the run and pass it to the plot so I can render both the plot and the DataTable on the same tab?

Thanks,
Glenn

# Non reactive code
ReturnTable <- array(...)

# reactive code

output$returntable <- renderDataTable({
do some stuff to populate return table
return(ReturnTable)
})

output$myplot <- renderPlot({
DatatoPlot <- ReturnTable
ggplot(...)
})
